dashboard.label: RedForesight — Test & Verify Pipeline
dashboard.description: Health and integrity checks across the agent, memory, and Splunk layers.

search.query: index=main sourcetype=_json source=redforesight_agent | stats count AS briefs, max(_time) AS last_brief | eval status=if(briefs>0,"healthy","idle") | table status, briefs, last_brief
index=main sourcetype=_json source=redforesight_agent | spath ranked_predictions{}.tactic | stats count by ranked_predictions{}.tactic | rename ranked_predictions{}.tactic AS Tactic

index=main sourcetype=_json source=redforesight_agent | spath top_prediction.technique_id | spath top_prediction.technique_name | stats count AS predictions by top_prediction.technique_id, top_prediction.technique_name | sort - predictions | head 10 | rename top_prediction.technique_id AS "TTP", top_prediction.technique_name AS "Technique", predictions AS "Times Predicted"

html.pre: Phase 1 — Connectivity: python scripts/run_local.py Phase 2 — MITRE Brain: python scripts/run_phase2_test.py Phase 3 — Orchestrator: python scripts/run_phase3_test.py Phase 4 — LLM + API loop: python scripts/run_phase4_test.py Unit tests (mocked): pytest Demo trigger (PowerShell): .\scripts\demo_trigger.ps1
